travel.title: Travel Agency
travel.description: Based in Etoug-Ebe, Yaoundé (Cameroon), our agency accompanies you in your travel and international mobility projects. Personalized advice, simplified procedures and tailor-made experience — every destination becomes an unforgettable adventure.

languages.title: Foreign Language Training
languages.description: English, German and other languages — face-to-face classes in Etoug-Ebe or online (text & video) with progress tracking by levels (A1 to C2). A dedicated teacher guides you to success.

courses.title: Course Catalog
courses.subtitle: Choose your language and level. From A1 (beginner) to C2 (proficient), each level is validated by an assessment before accessing the next level.
